findings.evidence:
for order in orders {
    let lines = db.lines_of_order(order.id)?;
findings.recommendation: Collect the order ids and fetch every line in one query with the existing `Db::lines_of_orders(&ids)` (api/src/db.rs:31, `WHERE order_id = ANY($1)`), then group the lines by `order_id` (e.g. a `HashMap<i64, i64>` of totals) while keeping the orders' `id DESC` order and an order with no line at 0. Cost today: 1 + N queries per customer page view (up to 101), growing with the customer's order count on a user-facing path; after the fix, 2.
